purpose: Nameplate-only reference. No battery gauge data available in the supplied analytics file.

nameplate.source: manufacturer specifications supplied with the device

energy_consistency: battery_energy_wh = 3.83V x 3110mAh = 11.911 Wh ~ 11.91 Wh. cell_energy_wh / rated capacity = 3.865 V, 0.035 V above nominal.
analytics_limitation: Contains only JetsamAggregationV3, WlpFixApsCountPerScanType1, HomeKit, Health and CableTypeChangedV2 records. No BatteryConfigValueHistogramFinal_V2 and no VacVoltageLimit, so CycleCount, NominalChargeCapacity, MaximumCapacityPercent and VacVoltageLimit cannot be obtained. The raw .ips is not published (contains crashreporter_key, incident_id and other identifiers).
prediction_basis: Same 4.45 V nameplate as reference-01, whose measured VacVoltageLimit at 1420 cycles is 4340 mV. Predicted only, NOT measured on this device.
